ledger.title: flb_pipe_create's pinned written sets are read by no route: it declares no cells
ledger.text: Registered by CELL-RESULT-SET-WRITTEN-SET-DERIVATION. `flb_pipe_create`'s `written_set(pipefd[0|1], [1, MAX]) when #result == 0` is pinned and derived at 66910c10, 34155955 and 046accf6 (fluent_bit/result_range.qv), but the function has no resource v1 declaration and no cell states, so its callers (flb_create's `ch_data`, flb_lib.c:181; flb_input_channel_init, flb_input.c:2219; the ingress channels, flb_input_ingest.c:488) stay `call to uncontracted function `flb_pipe_create`` and rule 38f never reads the sets. A slot cell names `#pointee` (element 0) only, so `pipefd[1]` needs a per-element slot place (G05d). DISCHARGE: a cell declaration of flb_pipe_create's two ends read through these written sets, with fixtures and a measurement; every reading it decides is attributed to the declared bound (CELL-RESULT-SET-DESCRIPTOR-ZERO-POLICY).

AMENDED (CELL-RESULT-SET-WRITTEN-SET-DERIVATION, 2026-11-04, docs/reports/cell-result-set-written-set-derivation/README.md): the pin-derived written sets of mk_event_channel_create (r_fd[0], w_fd[0]) and flb_pipe_create (pipefd[0..1]), [1, MAX] when #result == 0, rest on pipe's declared [1, MAX]; under POSIX's [0, MAX] the same bodies derive [0, MAX] and nothing is pinned. The slice's input_instance_channel_events_init creations at flb_input.c:1380 (34155955, units 0 and 1) pass the live-set check only through that bound (`descriptor-cell-undecided` in place of `descriptor-cell-live-set-unproved`).

AMENDED (CELL-RESULT-SET-WRITTEN-SET-DERIVATION, 2026-11-04, docs/reports/cell-result-set-written-set-derivation/README.md): mk_event_channel_create's pin now also carries derived written sets (r_fd[0], w_fd[0] [1, MAX] when #result == 0, derived over each Fluent Bit tree's configured epoll unit). The corpus's standalone Monkey units are a libevent build, whose body derives nothing (evutil_socketpair states no written set; fixture a_backend_whose_call_states_no_written_set_derives_nothing), yet read the Fluent Bit-tree pin; no corpus Monkey unit creates into a cell with a declared live set, so nothing reads them there today. The same holds for a build configured with another backend than the derivation's (the identity's sites are lexical): the discharge should key a derivation to the configuration it read.
